title: New U.S. Survey of Military Service Members and Veterans with Non-Muscle Invasive Bladder Cancer Reveals 53% Were Diagnosed at Age 50 or Younger and Barriers to Care
summary: CULVER CITY, Calif., November 11, 2026--ImmunityBio, Inc. (NASDAQ: IBRX), a commercial-stage immunotherapy company, today announced findings from a national survey of military service members and veterans with non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC). The survey, conducted by The Harris Poll on behalf of ImmunityBio, found that 53% of respondents were diagnosed by age 50 and 63% reported barriers or challenges to receiving treatment.
